category_title: Quiet students with ambiguous comprehension during independent work
minimal_context: The student is working independently on a computer-based assignment using the Novanet online instructional program.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please log into the Novanet online instructional program and continue your self-paced lesson on the computer.

STUDENT: (Stares blankly at the monitor) This program is boring.

TUTOR: What do you think you should do next on the screen?

STUDENT: I don't know. I do not seem to learn from the online lessons.

TUTOR: Just keep trying to read through the material.

STUDENT: (Puts their head on the desk, gets distracted, and begins to text on their cell phone instead of looking at the assignment.)

options.A: Monitor the student's progress on the computer using a monitor device to check their work, and provide immediate feedback on the assignment.
options.B: Agree with the student that they are having a rough time with the online instructional program during the current computer-based assignment.
options.C: Withhold attention from the student when they engage in the problem behavior of texting and putting their head down on the desk.
options.D: Step away from the computer station to get a drink of water if feeling frustrated by the student's disengagement during the session.
